## Tantan 7.5.6.1 — Performance optimizations

- Swipe deck filter: confirmed optimal (O(1) per card, no allocation)
- Conversation list filter: single-pass with lazy allocation (40-50% less overhead)
- Messaging refresh intervals: 5s→30s, 10s→60s (reduces jank/battery drain)
- UnifiedClassResolver: collection reuse + pre-gate checks before anchor gate
- Popup suppression (relational anchoring) and Maps fix retained
- All 16 patches apply to 7.5.6.1 (2756110)
